info.title: OnHold API
info.description:
The OnHold platform core. The web app uses exactly this API; nothing is hidden.

Authenticate with the session cookie (browsers; send `X-CSRF-Token` on writes) or `Authorization: Bearer ohk_…` (API keys). Workspace routes need `X-Workspace-Id` unless an API key implies it. Errors are `{"error": {"code", "message", "field"?}}`. Writes accept `Idempotency-Key` for safe retries; records with a `version` accept `If-Match`.

post.summary:
Act inside a customer's workspace for support, for up to an hour. Every
change made meanwhile is flagged in their audit log.

delete.summary: Stop acting inside a customer's workspace.

post.summary: Create a workspace and invite its owner.

get.summary: This workspace's API keys (never their secrets).

delete.summary: Revoke an API key. Requests using it fail immediately.

parameters.name: before
parameters.description: Return entries older than this entry id (the previous page's `next_before`).

get.summary: The audit log as CSV (newest first, up to 100,000 rows).

post.summary: Sign in with email and password.
post.description:
Sets the session cookie. If the user has two-factor authentication on,
`mfa_required` is true and the session only becomes usable after
`POST /auth/mfa/verify`.

post.summary: Email a one-time sign-in link. Always 202, whether or not the address has an account.
Sign in with the token from a magic link.

get.summary: The signed-in user, their workspaces and this session.

post.summary: Finish signing in with a TOTP or recovery code.

get.summary: The single sign-on providers this deployment has configured.
Where the provider sends the browser back. Redirects into the web app.
Redirect to the provider's sign-in page.

parameters.name: invitation
parameters.description: An invitation token to accept as part of signing in.

parameters.name: redirect
parameters.description: A path in the web app to return to afterwards.

parameters.name: link
parameters.description: Link this provider to the signed-in account instead of signing in.

post.summary: Set or change the password. Signs out every other session.

get.summary: Every active session of the signed-in user.

delete.summary: Sign out one of your sessions (for example a lost phone).

post.summary: Confirm setup with a code from the app; returns recovery codes.
Replace all recovery codes with a new set.

get.summary: Invitations sent from this workspace, newest first.

post.summary: Invite someone by email. The link is emailed to them (delivery starts in M2).
Accept an invitation, as the signed-in user or by creating an account.

get.summary: What an invitation is for, so the accept page can show it.

delete.summary: Withdraw an invitation that hasn't been accepted.

get.summary: Everyone with access to this workspace.

delete.summary: Remove a member's access. Their past work stays attributed to them.

patch.summary:
Change a member's role. Only owners can give or take away `owner`, and
the last owner cannot be demoted.
Change workspace settings. Only the fields sent are changed.

post.summary: Close the workspace. Data is kept; every member loses access.

get.summary: Roles, what each may do, and what the caller may do (for showing or hiding UI).

Liveness: the process is up and serving. Never touches dependencies, so a
database outage does not get every container restarted.
Readiness: the process can do useful work, which today means the database answers.

name.description: Required when nobody is signed in (a new account is created).

password.description: Required when nobody is signed in.

oneOf.description: Present when a new account was created and signed in.
Set when an OnHold operator made the change while supporting this workspace.

next_before.description: Pass as `before` for the next page; absent on the last page.

confirm_slug.description: The workspace's slug, typed again to confirm.

permissions.description: What the key may do; at most what you can do yourself.

slug.description: Lowercase letters, digits and inner hyphens; permanent.

secret.description: The key itself. Shown once; store it somewhere safe.

owner_invitation_url.description: The owner's join link. Until email delivery lands (M2), pass it on yourself.

field.description: The request field at fault, for validation errors.

oneOf.description: Set while an operator is acting inside a customer's workspace; the UI must show it.

workspaces.description: Workspaces this user belongs to (empty while a second factor is pending).

code.description: The 6-digit code from the authenticator app.

recovery_code.description: Or one of the single-use recovery codes.

current_password.description: Required when the account already has a password.

Perspective.description:
Whether the workspace represents talent (`sells`), books talent for its
own events (`buys`), or both. Changes vocabulary and defaults, never the
data model.

recovery_codes.description: Shown once. Each works once if the authenticator app is lost.

Role.description: A workspace membership role. A fixed set in v1.

roles.description: Permissions per role in this workspace.

propertyNames.description: A workspace membership role. A fixed set in v1.

csrf_token.description: Send this as `X-CSRF-Token` on every write made with the session cookie.

mfa_required.description: When true, call `POST /auth/mfa/verify` before anything else.

reason.description: Recorded in the customer's audit log.

otpauth_url.description: Render as a QR code for the authenticator app.

secret.description: The same secret in base32, for typing in by hand.

UserId.description: A person who can sign in.

WorkspaceId.description: A workspace: one tenant's data boundary.

version.description: Send back as `If-Match` when saving to avoid overwriting someone else's change.
